column4: detail
Visitor can view a published, responsive homepage with biography, featured work and clear calls to action
Public about page shows only owner-approved profile information
Published projects support ordering, featured status and detail navigation
Each published project has stable slug URL and engineering case study
Published research entries show their actual statuses and categories
Research page supports methods, datasets, results, limits and links
Published education records display in configured order
Published work history displays appropriate dates and roles
Skills are grouped into editable categories and rendered publicly
Certifications and achievements with optional verification URLs appear when published
Published articles have listing and individual pages
Public resume download works when enabled, and is hidden when disabled
Visitor can submit validated contact message and receive non-misleading success/failure feedback
Public social/profile links derive from admin settings
Visitors can filter projects/research/articles by supported attributes
Owner can publish notable public contributions
Owner can publish talks/events and links
Anonymous visitors cannot read private admin content or use admin mutations
Admin can edit and publish profile and site biography
Admin can manage education and experience records
Admin can create/update/reorder/archive projects
Admin can create/update/archive research items and publications
Admin can manage skills and display categories
Admin can manage certifications and achievements
Admin can write rich-text articles and manage references
Admin can upload, reuse, replace and safely remove images/PDFs
Publishable content supports draft, preview, publish and unpublish
Important publishable content keeps restorable prior revisions
Admin can edit global site content, visibility and contact options
Admin can choose which published items appear on homepage
Admin can edit title/description/social image for supported pages
Admin can review contact submissions with retention/deletion controls
Admin can reorder predefined homepage sections without editing code
Admin can choose from safe approved color/theme presets
Admin mutations and significant security events generate safe audit records
Admin can schedule future publication
Optional GitHub integrations can sync selected public repository metadata
Admin account is provisioned securely with no open registration
Valid password is required before login challenge
Short-lived one-use verified email challenge completes login
Sessions expire, can be revoked and end on logout
Verified owner can complete secure password recovery
Every private endpoint checks authenticated administrator status
Old published URLs redirect appropriately when slugs change
Only published data appears in anonymous SSR, APIs, feeds or sitemap
Verified admin receives notification when configured, without treating failed delivery as successful
Server validates authorized upload type, size and ownership
Application exposes safe liveness/readiness behavior for hosting
Critical server/application errors are observable without secret leakage
Database backup and restore operations are documented and tested
Public published canonical URLs appear in an XML sitemap
Admin can handle deletion and retention of contact messages
WCAG 2.2 AA target for public and admin experiences
Small phone through desktop; no unusable horizontal scrolling
Public core pages expose crawlable server-rendered content
75th percentile LCP <=2.5 s, INP <=200 ms, CLS <=0.1 as target
Industry-standard Argon2id password hashing; no plaintext storage
Secure HttpOnly cookie configuration, rotation/revocation and server storage
Deny-by-default access to unpublished/admin resources
Authenticated mutations CSRF-protected; rich content sanitized/safely rendered
All untrusted inputs validated on server; client validation enhances usability
Server-side type/size checks; file storage outside application deploy filesystem
Foreign keys, uniqueness, migrations and transactions on critical writes
Automated backups and documented tested isolated restoration
All production traffic served over HTTPS with appropriate redirects
Collect minimum personal data; public visibility explicitly controlled
99.9% monthly availability aspirational target, not provider guarantee
Structured logs, meaningful errors and production error monitoring
Modules separated by domain; documented interfaces and repeatable scripts
Current Chrome, Safari, Edge and Firefox; keyboard-only usage
No credentials in repository or browser bundle
Tested staging before controlled production release
Expired/used codes reject; notification failures handled clearly
Unicode support, UTC stored dates and locale-aware rendering
P0 requirements have explicit, repeatable acceptance tests
Infrastructure and provider usage monitored against budget
